title: Segment Tree
definition: A binary tree used for storing intervals or segments. It allows querying array intervals (like 'Sum of elements from index 2 to 7') and updating array elements both in O(log N) time.
simpleExplanation: A pre-calculated spreadsheet that lets you instantly find out the total sales between any two dates, even if the daily sales numbers keep changing.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Segment Tree.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Segment Tree to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Segment Tree into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Segment Tree.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Segment Tree from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
